nodes.label: Browser-computed planning architecture
nodes.rationale: The browser computes plans on every edit while server components load routes and server actions persist them.

nodes.label: Ordered-itinerary checkpoint deadline
nodes.rationale: Prefix sums include descents before the last exposed segment and later climbs in the remaining itinerary; the checkpoint is not a reverse-route bailout.

nodes.label: Ordered JSON route segments
nodes.rationale: One JSON array makes reordering an array swap and saving one route update, keeping persistence simple.
